item.text: {"summary":"Fix UTF-8 to UTF-16 result length and supplementary-plane encoding.","explanation":"The checked-in `util_test.utf8_to_utf16` assertions expect `u.str()` to contain exactly the seven decoded characters and `u.size()` to be 7; the failure reports a trailing NUL and size 8. The empty-string test expects an empty string and size 0, but reports a NUL and size 1. The converter needs to keep its terminator for `c_str()` while excluding it from the content length. The same test source expects U+10437 to encode as D801 DC37; the current `cp >> 9` high-surrogate calculation produces the wrong high surrogate. Shifting by 10 computes the required 10-bit offset. Invalid UTF-8 handling remains unchanged.","edits":[{"path":"include/fmt/format.h","old":"  inline auto size() const -> size_t { return buffer_.size(); }","new":"  inline auto size() const -> size_t { return buffer_.size() - 1; }"},{"path":"include/fmt/format-inl.h","old":"      buffer_.push_back(static_cast<wchar_t>(0xD800 + (cp >> 9)));","new":"      buffer_.push_back(static_cast<wchar_t>(0xD800 + (cp >> 10)));"}]}
